ttm_diagnostics.calculation_trace: FY2026 + H1 FY2027 - H1 FY2026. NVIDIA-defined FCF uses OCF less PPE/intangible purchases and related principal payments. The SBC subtraction is a separate conservative owner-cash diagnostic and not a company-defined measure.

reverse_expectations.method: Retain the 2026-09-06 base model architecture: year-1 revenue USD 500B, owner-margin path 39%,38%,37%,36%, then 35%, 22x terminal multiple and 9% required return; solve one revenue growth rate for years 2-10 that matches the synchronized price.
reverse_expectations.interpretation: The current price requires roughly 9.6% annual revenue growth after a USD 500B year-1 base under strong owner-cash economics. This is demanding in duration, but it is not an obviously unrealistic bull-case requirement given current AI-infrastructure growth. The result is highly sensitive to owner margins and terminal economics.

bear.narrative: AI infrastructure ROI disappoints, hyperscalers shift more workloads to custom silicon, China becomes structurally inaccessible, supply and customer-support commitments crystallize while owner margins normalize sharply, and the terminal multiple compresses.

base.narrative: Blackwell-to-Rubin execution sustains platform leadership, AI factory buildout remains economically useful, revenue compounds at a strong but decelerating rate and mature owner margin settles near 35%.

bull.narrative: Rubin, networking, inference, sovereign AI, physical AI and software expand the addressable market while NVIDIA retains full-stack pricing power and ecosystem investments create additional durable demand without impairing capital returns.

two_state_price_position.note: Algebraic location between modeled endpoints, not an estimated probability.

capital_allocation_adjustments.treatment: Not mechanically stacked as immediate losses. They are correlated AI-cycle exposures and are handled in scenario severity, management/capital-allocation score, hard-veto investigation and falsifiers.

valuation_conclusion: At USD 223.67 the stock is approximately 1.3% above the retained base value of USD 220.78. Current price no longer requires the prior 10.0% reverse growth rate, but there is still no clear base-case margin of safety. WATCH remains appropriate until customer ROI and the returns on ecosystem financing/investment are better evidenced.
